_roadmap: OPS/units/COMP-COCKPIT-RIBBON-CUT-1/cut.md; owner pick Day ribbon, OPS/units/COMP-COCKPIT-UX-ADJ-1/report.md Shape 1
_note: The feed author copies this file to C/docs/features/COMP-COCKPIT-RIBBON-FEED-1/ribbon-contract.json in the landing commit. RIBBON-ROWS-1 builds against fixtures of this shape. Times are ISO-8601 strings with offset; null means not recorded, never zero.

errors.400: {error} when from/to missing, unparseable, from >= to, or to - from > 31 days
errors.absent: route not mounted in remote mode (same guard as /api/process)

lanes.idle: bool: no current unit and no span or mark in the window
lanes.paused: bool (COMP-DAYVIEW-SPLIT-2): the lane is listed in fleet.paused of the target root's .compose/compose.json, read fresh on every request (cache hits included). A paused lane is drawn muted with a "paused" label and is never idle, stale or waiting on you on the Day view. `idle` keeps its own meaning. A missing key pauses nothing; a malformed one pauses nothing and the route logs one WARNING per distinct problem.
lanes.current: {id, title, titleSource, since} | null (null in a past window)

spans.since: iso | undefined: the span's real start when the window cut `start` (stamp spans carry it from a unit's first stamp; an owner stamp span carries its own stamp's start, not the start of the piece left after job time is cut out; owner-queue spans always carry the ask's time); the client reads it for lane state and the last stamp
spans.open: bool | undefined: a stamp span with no end of its own, extended to now (work and wait stamps). An owner stamp span is `open: false` once it is clipped at the owner-queue read or cut around its queue ask (lib/owner-spans.js)
spans.queueId: string | undefined: owner-queue id; present only on an owner wait that came from the queue (cause 'owner'), absent on stamp spans
spans.qid: string | undefined: owner stamp spans only (cause 'owner', no `queueId`): the id of the owner-queue ask the stamp records (`owner_waits[].qid`), absent when the stamp has none. The route matches the stamp to the queue ask with `queueId === qid` on any lane; only a stamp with no `qid` is matched by unit and a start within 10 min (lib/owner-spans.js). Client rule for 'at now': an owner span counts only with a `queueId` or `open: true` (`ownerAtNow`, ribbonLayout.js)
spans.laneGuess: bool | undefined: queue owner waits only. true when no lane was named and the ask is shown on the ops row (the tooltip says so)
spans.laneRule: 'stamp-lane' | 'asked-elsewhere' | undefined: which lane rule the route applied to a cross-lane ask (COMP-DAYVIEW-OWNER-IDENTITY-FU-1). 'stamp-lane': a queue span whose ask had no named lane (`laneGuess`) was moved onto the lane of the unit whose stamp carries its id (`laneGuess` is then false). 'asked-elsewhere': a MIRROR span on the stamp's lane (cause 'owner', no `queueId`, `open: false`) for time an ask drawn on another lane covers; it carries `askedOn` (that lane) and `askQid` (that ask). The lane reads 'waiting on you (asked on <lane>)'; a mirror is never an ask: no Needs-you marker, no count (`ownerAtNow` is false). Absent when the stamp and its ask share a lane
spans.askedOn: string | undefined: mirror spans only (laneRule 'asked-elsewhere'): the lane the ask is drawn on
spans.askQid: string | undefined: mirror spans only: the queue id of the ask this span mirrors; the span is dropped with that ask when it is no longer open (`withOwnerOpen`)
spans.title: string | null
spans.why: plain words for the tooltip, e.g. 'waiting on review 3 h' or 'not recorded: no dispatch stamp (rule U-d)'

marks.title: string | null
marks.reverse: string | null (decide only: how to reverse, from the source row)

lanes.eta: {p50, p80, asOf, raw, prev: {p50, asOf} | null} | {noData: true, raw} | null. p50 and p80 are strings exactly as estimate.py prints them: a duration such as "9h" or "2d" (the live shape), and a time with an offset is also read. asOf is the estimator's own local time WITHOUT a zone ("2026-10-31T20:14"). raw is the estimator's debug line and is never shown.

sourceErrors.<source>: string (plain words; the source still renders as not recorded)
